chapters.screen: k-Nearest Neighbours. k-nearest neighbours learns no formula. It stores every passenger and, for a new one, looks up the k most similar: their survival share is the prediction. The only real choice is k; watch what too few and too many neighbours do to the maps.
chapters.spoken: k-Nearest Neighbours. k-nearest neighbours learns no formula. It stores every passenger and, for a new one, looks up the k most similar: their survival share is the prediction. The only real choice is k; watch what too few and too many neighbours do to the maps.

chapters.screen: Each mark is one passenger: age (x) and fare paid (y, log scale); women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.
chapters.spoken: Each mark is one passenger: age and fare paid on a log scale; women on the left, men on the right. Blue dots survived, red crosses did not.

chapters.screen: Training is just storing 627 passengers. With k = 1 every point copies the single most similar passenger, so the maps are a speckled 0% / 100% patchwork.
chapters.spoken: Training is just storing 627 passengers. With k equals 1 every point copies the single most similar passenger, so the maps are a speckled 0% or 100% patchwork.

chapters.screen: Each frame refits with a larger k (no weights, no gradients). Similarity uses scaled age, fare and sex: small neighbourhoods stay within one sex, very large ones must mix both.
chapters.spoken: Each frame refits with a larger k (no weights, no gradients). Similarity uses scaled age, fare and sex: small neighbourhoods stay within one sex, very large ones must mix both.

chapters.screen: Validation chose k = 64: train accuracy 77%, validation 78%. Small k chases noise; huge k drifts towards the overall rate.
chapters.spoken: Validation chose k equals 64: train accuracy 77%, validation 78%. Small k chases noise; huge k drifts towards the overall rate.

chapters.screen: The unseen passenger finds the 64 most similar passengers (teal rings); the share of them who survived is the probability.
chapters.spoken: The unseen passenger finds the 64 most similar passengers (teal rings); the share of them who survived is the probability.

chapters.screen: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.
chapters.spoken: Final exam: the trained model judges all 210 test passengers it has never seen. Wrong calls are circled on the maps and crossed in the grid, grouped by class of travel.

chapters.screen: kNN takes the vote of the nearest passengers, so each sheet is a patchwork of flat patches. Height is the model's P(survive), one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.
chapters.spoken: kNN takes the vote of the nearest passengers, so each sheet is a patchwork of flat patches. Height is the model's chance of survival, one sheet per sex, seen by a swinging camera.

chapters.screen: About the same: 84% with every input against 82% with age, fare and sex.
chapters.spoken: About the same: 84% with every input against 82% with age, fare and sex.

chapters.screen: kNN predicts by analogy: similar passengers probably shared a fate, and k sets how many to trust. Limitation: every prediction searches the stored passengers, and the answer depends on how the inputs are scaled: 'similar' is a choice, not a fact.
chapters.spoken: kNN predicts by analogy: similar passengers probably shared a fate, and k sets how many to trust. Limitation: every prediction searches the stored passengers, and the answer depends on how the inputs are scaled: 'similar' is a choice, not a fact.
